name: films
description: List all Studio Ghibli films (up to optional limit), returning title, director, producer, release year, running time, Rotten Tomatoes score, and related character/location/vehicle URLs.

name: people
description: List Studio Ghibli characters (up to optional limit), returning name, gender, age, eye/hair color, species, and the films they appear in.

name: locations
description: List fictional locations from Studio Ghibli films (up to optional limit), returning name, climate, terrain, surface water, and the films they appear in.

name: species
description: List species that appear in Studio Ghibli films (up to optional limit), returning name, classification, eye/hair colors, and the films and characters associated with that species.

name: vehicles
description: List vehicles from Studio Ghibli films (up to optional limit), returning name, description, vehicle class, length, pilot, and the film it appears in.
